string-array.name: onb_story
string-array.item: Working with many service providers, I noticed how they build [[personal branding]].
They all do 2 common things:
1. They share helpful tips about their service.
2. They NEVER miss their posting schedule.
But there is a problem. If you don\'t post regularly, social media stops showing your posts to [[more people]].
And today, videos get the most reach.
Now the question is: what kind of video builds the most trust?
Many people paid for bad service after watching a perfectly edited video. So fancy, faceless videos still get views. But not [[trust]].
A real face, speaking honestly, builds [[more trust]]. That is why service providers now show their face.
But one video takes a lot of work.
Write a script. Record. Edit. Resize for every platform (9:16, 4:5, 3:4). Post everywhere. Every single day. 30 days a month.
Skip a few days, and any social media platform will reduce your views.
So most service providers hire two people:
1. A video editor
2. A social media manager
That is a big [[cost]] every month.
For the last three years, I was thinking how to bring this cost down.
So I built an app. Open it. Talk for [[2-3 minutes]]. Close it. [[The app does all the rest]].
You stay consistent. No editor. No manager. No extra cost.
You start building your [[personal brand]].
